description.en: The instance ID of Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA).

description.zh: 访问日志携带自定义头字段名称列表
description.en: A list of custom header field names to be included in access logs.

description.zh:
访问日志是否开启携带自定义头字段。取值：

- **true**：是。
- **false**（默认值）：否。

> 只有实例访问日志开关**AccessLogEnabled**打开时，才能设置此参数为**true**。
description.en:
Specifies whether to include custom headers in access logs. Valid values:

- **true**: Yes.
- **false** (default): No.

> You can set this parameter to **true** only when the **AccessLogEnabled** toggle for the instance is turned on.
The ID of the endpoint group.

description.zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou。
description.en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. The only valid value is cn-hangzhou.
The name of the Data Service Project.
